text:
Marie (partnerships): Heads up — SI + HSM vendor are targeting a joint marketplace listing + press next month. Need an integration crosswalk for on-prem KMS, SAML/SCIM, and SSO flows. Can we align runway? :eyes:
Ava - Security PM: Thanks. Key constraints: HSM BYOK vs vendor-managed, customer key import flow, cert rotation window, and attestation docs. I'll draft a security checklist.
Ravi (eng-runtime): I need a compatibility matrix: chip families, PKCS#11 versions, ed25519 signing support, and whether the vendor exposes gRPC vs REST connectors. Also sequence for rollout: dev sandbox -> staging -> dedicated -> private.
Ben - SE: Solutions can run a 1:1 pilot with the SI next week. Need sample Terraform snippets, adapter README, and SCIM scoping for groups/provisioning + attribute mapping.
Clara - Legal: We'll need PR review, embargo list, and the partner NDA snippet if they want pre-announcement access. Send me the partner legal contacts.
ops-bot: deploy-sandbox created for "keyforge-pilot" — url: https://sandbox.redwood.internal/keyforge (expires in 7d) :rocket: 
Marie (partnerships): Proposed timeline: Week 1: crosswalk doc + security checklist. Week 2: pilot and end-to-end test. Week 3: marketing assets + legal signoff. Week 4: press rehearsal + release. Can folks ack and add gaps?
Ava - Security PM: Ack. I'll own checklist. ETA Tue EOD.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Ack. I'll put together the compatibility matrix and a small adapter demo. ETA Wed.
Ben - SE: Ack. I'll schedule pilot kickoff with partner (Thu 10:00 PT).
Clara - Legal: Ack. I'll draft NDA and embargo terms and route to ops for calendar hold.
Marie (partnerships): Quick ask — include a short runbook for fallback to cloud-managed keys if HSM path fails. Put it under a doc section titled `Operational fallbacks`.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Good call. I'll add a 3-step failover snippet:```yaml
failover:
  - step: mute_hsm
  - step: switch_to_kms_managed_v2
  - step: annotate_audit_log_with_marker
```
Ben - SE: Also add a support training checklist: mapping of error codes -> likely cause -> fallthrough steps, and an example incident playbook.
Marie (partnerships): Marketing note — do NOT use partner logos until legal OK. We'll rehearse spokes on Dec 12 09:00 PT. I'll send a calendar invite after legal signoff. :calendar:
Clara - Legal: Will update the embargoed-partners list and send legal-review thread.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: press-rehearsal created Dec 12 09:00 PT (invites pending legal).
Marie (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll create the crosswalk doc (template + compatibility matrix + checklist) and post a draft link in this thread by EOD. If you have any quick wins to add, drop them here. :+1:
